snippet.title: The Plant Shop - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
FREE DEMO out now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4140530/The_Plant_Shop/
https://torigamedev.itch.io/the-plant-shop

A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.
